```{r}
#| label: purpose
#| include: false
# =============================================================================
# Purpose : NTD raw data: capital expenses and the agency directory
#           (city/state per ntd_id).
# Sources :
#   Capital, 2014-2021     : per-year .xlsx from FTA (transit.dot.gov)
#   Capital, 2022-2024     : data.transportation.gov Socrata view fphd-jyyj
#   Agency Info, 2014-2024 : per-year .xlsx from FTA (transit.dot.gov)
# Outputs : file existence + integrity validation only (no R-side artifact)
# =============================================================================
```

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
here::i_am("_quarto.yml")
ntd_dir <- here("data", "raw", "ntd")
```

## Source URLs (for reference / re-acquisition)

```{r}
#| label: url-table
capital_urls <- tibble::tribble(
  ~year, ~xlsx_url,
  2014L, "https://www.transit.dot.gov/sites/fta.dot.gov/files/2014%20Capital%20Use.xlsx",
  2015L, "https://www.transit.dot.gov/sites/fta.dot.gov/files/2015_Capital_Use.xlsx",
  2016L, "https://www.transit.dot.gov/sites/fta.dot.gov/files/2016%20Capital%20Use.xlsx",
  2017L, "https://www.transit.dot.gov/sites/fta.dot.gov/files/2017%20Capital%20Use.xlsx",
  2018L, "https://www.transit.dot.gov/sites/fta.dot.gov/files/2018%20Capital%20Use.xlsx",
  2019L, "https://www.transit.dot.gov/sites/fta.dot.gov/files/2020-10/2019%20Capital%20Use.xlsx",
  2020L, "https://www.transit.dot.gov/sites/fta.dot.gov/files/2021-11/2020%20Capital%20Use.xlsx",
  2021L, "https://www.transit.dot.gov/sites/fta.dot.gov/files/2022-10/2021%20Capital%20Use.xlsx"
)

socrata_url <- "https://data.transportation.gov/resource/fphd-jyyj.csv?$limit=5000000"

capital_urls |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "FTA Capital Use xlsx URLs (2014-2021)") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

## File integrity validation

```{r}
#| label: integrity
validate_xlsx <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(list(status = "MISSING", bytes = NA_integer_, magic = NA_character_))
  bytes <- file.info(path)$size
  fh <- file(path, "rb"); on.exit(close(fh))
  hdr <- readBin(fh, what = "raw", n = 4)
  magic <- paste(format(hdr), collapse = "-")
  list(status = if (magic == "50-4b-03-04") "OK" else "BAD_MAGIC",
       bytes = bytes, magic = magic)
}

xlsx_check <- capital_urls |>
  mutate(
    path  = file.path(ntd_dir, sprintf("capital_use_%d.xlsx", year)),
    info  = map(path, validate_xlsx),
    status = map_chr(info, "status"),
    bytes  = map_int(info, "bytes"),
    magic  = map_chr(info, "magic")
  ) |>
  select(year, path = path, status, bytes, magic)

xlsx_check |>
  mutate(path = basename(path)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "xlsx integrity check") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

if (any(xlsx_check$status != "OK")) {
  stop("One or more capital xlsx files missing or invalid. Re-acquire from the URLs above.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: socrata-check
socrata_path <- file.path(ntd_dir, "ntd_capital_socrata_raw.csv")
if (!file.exists(socrata_path)) {
  cat("[DOWNLOAD] Fetching Socrata capital data...\n")
  resp <- httr2::request(socrata_url) |>
    httr2::req_options(ssl_verifypeer = 0L) |>
    httr2::req_headers("User-Agent" = "Mozilla/5.0 Recalls-Thesis") |>
    httr2::req_timeout(300) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    httr2::req_perform()
  writeBin(httr2::resp_body_raw(resp), socrata_path)
}
cat(sprintf("Socrata capital CSV: %s (%.1f KB)\n",
            basename(socrata_path), file.info(socrata_path)$size / 1024))
```

```{r}
#| label: agency-info-integrity
ai_check <- agency_info_urls |>
  mutate(
    path  = file.path(ntd_dir, sprintf("agency_info_%d.xlsx", year)),
    info  = map(path, validate_xlsx),
    status = map_chr(info, "status"),
    bytes  = map_int(info, "bytes"),

  ) |>
  select(year, path = path, status, bytes, magic)

ai_check |>
  mutate(path = basename(path)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Agency Information xlsx integrity check") |>

if (any(ai_check$status != "OK")) {
```
